summary: All 3 tests in the Product Overview suite failed. Failures are due to missing elements and timeouts indicating possible selector mismatches or application issues.
rootCause: The tests failed because key elements identified by data-testid selectors were not found or visible within the timeout period, suggesting that the selectors do not match the current application DOM or the application did not render the expected elements in time.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify grid of product cards is displayed on home page
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('[data-testid="product-grid"]')).toBeVisible() failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' did not match any visible element on the page, possibly due to UI changes or incorrect selector.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' is correct and that the element is present and visible on the home page. Update the selector if the UI has changed.

failedTests.testName: TC-002 - Verify product card details are displayed
failedTests.likelyCause: No product cards were found matching the selector, likely due to selector mismatch or the product grid not rendering any cards.
failedTests.recommendation: Check if the selector used to locate product cards is correct and if the application is rendering product cards as expected. Investigate if test data or application state is causing zero product cards to appear.

failedTests.testName: TC-003 - Verify navigation to product detail page from product card
failedTests.errorMessage: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for locator('[data-testid="product-card"]').first().locator('[data-testid="product-name"]').innerText()
failedTests.likelyCause: The element '[data-testid="product-name"]' inside the first product card was not found or not rendered within the timeout, possibly due to selector mismatch or application loading issues.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify the selectors for product cards and product names are correct. Check application performance and loading behavior to ensure elements appear within expected time. Consider increasing timeout if necessary.

recommendations: Review and validate all data-testid selectors used in the tests against the current application DOM.
Confirm that the application is rendering the product grid and product cards correctly with the expected test data.
Investigate application logs or UI changes that might have caused elements to be missing or delayed.
Consider adding retries or increasing timeouts if the application is slow to render elements.
If selectors are confirmed correct and application is stable, review test implementation for possible defects.
releaseImpact: High - All tests in the critical Product Overview feature failed, blocking validation of product listing and navigation functionality.
